name: @omp-dev-team/token-diet
description: Token-reduction toolkit for OMP: RTK + CodeGraph + caveman.
comment: Ships an MCP server (CodeGraph), an always-on rule (rtk/codegraph routing), three skills, and a setup script. No omp.extensions — the heavy lifting is external binaries (rtk, codegraph) wired via .mcp.json + rules.
